Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

4. WorkmaiMhip and Finish 

4.1 The scissor^ shall be symmetrical and well balanced* 

4.2 The blades shall open and close without stiffness and shall have a slight cross-over action to giv^ 
a continuous pinch. There shall be no play at the joint. 

4.3 The scissors shall be free from cracks^ seams, burrs i|nd other defects. 

4.4 The scissors shall be finished smooth, passiva^ aiild polished bright. 

4.5 All the edges shall be even. The edges ahall be rouindad except the cutting edges, which shall be 
sharp and shall not have any feather. 

5. Heat Traatmani — The seizors shall be unlfo/ftilY Hardened end tempered to 650 to 600 HV, 

I. Taata 

•.1 Per/brtiwffcafa^— Use the scissors to cut a ii^^rf llbing having 8 mm outer diameter. The 
scissors shall cut the tubing cleanly and shall not show|an^'sign of damage. 

S«2 Corrosion Resistance Tes^ — Scrub the scissors w^b ioap and warm water, rinse in hot water and 
then dip in 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the scissors, \ imrrierse in copii^er sulphate solution at roofi; 
temperature for 6 minutes and wash with fresh water or swab with wet cotton wool. 

The copper sulphate solution shall be made up sk follows: 

Copper sulphate ( CuS04.5H|0 ) 4-0 g 

Sulphuric acid (HjSO*) (spgrV84) lO'O g 

Distilled wat^rr see IS: 1070*1 960 900 ml 

Specification for water, distilled 
quality {revised)] 

There shall be no red stains or spots on the scissors after the test, but dulling of the polished 
surface may be permitted. 

7. Marking — The scissors shall be merked with the f<»llowing: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) The words ' stainless steel '. 

7,1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1 1 0001 . 

8. Packing — The scissor shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or packed in polyethylene bags, 
avoiding contact with one another.

Alteration
